node_versions_content_check.name: node_versions_content_check
node_versions_content_check.value:
case when "node_versions"."state" = 'live'
    then ("node_versions"."blob_sha256" is null) <> ("node_versions"."json_value" is null)
    else "node_versions"."blob_sha256" is null and "node_versions"."json_value" is null end

trees_name_check.name: trees_name_check
trees_name_check.value: length("trees"."name") between 1 and 63 and "trees"."name" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*' and "trees"."name" not glob '-*'

workspaces_name_check.name: workspaces_name_check
workspaces_name_check.value: length("workspaces"."name") between 1 and 63 and "workspaces"."name" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*' and "workspaces"."name" not glob '-*' and "workspaces"."name" not in ('api', 'cli')
